meta.title: Source Gaps Registry
meta.description: Tracks official authorities referenced in other datasets that do not yet have a verified entry in data/sources.en.json. Each entry represents a gap to be closed by verifying the authority's official portal and adding a sources entry.

data.name: General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT)
data.reason_needed: GASTAT is the primary official statistical authority for Saudi Arabia, publishing national accounts (GDP by sector), labor force surveys, FDI statistics, and ICT indicators. It is not yet referenced in any current dataset but is the expected authoritative source for future economic and statistical indicator datasets — including FDI flows, sector growth, labor market indicators, and digital economy indicators. Verifying GASTAT's data catalog and publication methodology is required before any such dataset can be added to this repository.
data.next_verification_step: Navigate directly to stats.gov.sa. Confirm the domain resolves to the General Authority for Statistics portal. Review the data catalog for national accounts, labor force surveys, FDI statistics, and ICT publications. Note the publication schedule, reference periods, and methodology documentation available for each series. Then add a verified entry to data/sources.en.json using the source review template and remove this gap or set verification_status to verified.

placeholders.description: The domain stats.gov.sa is recorded as the likely official portal for the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) but has not been independently confirmed.

GASTAT is not yet referenced in any current dataset. It is pre-registered here because it is the expected authoritative source for future economic and statistical indicator datasets (FDI flows, sector growth, labor market indicators, digital economy indicators). Update this field when a dataset referencing GASTAT is added.

data.name: Chambers of Commerce (NCCI)
data.name_alt: الغرف التجارية — الاتحاد الوطني للغرف التجارية الصناعية
data.reason_needed: Chamber of Commerce annual membership is a mandatory cost for businesses registered in Saudi Arabia. Fees vary by company class (SAR 800–10,000+/year). The National Committee for Chambers of Commerce and Industry (NCCI) and local chambers are the relevant bodies. The chamber_of_commerce_fee entry in data/fees.en.json references this authority_id. Verifying the official domain and fee schedule by class is required before that fee entry can move from verified to a full source entry.
data.next_verification_step: Navigate directly to chamber.org.sa or the relevant local chamber portal. Confirm the domain resolves to the National Committee for Chambers of Commerce and Industry or the relevant local chamber. Review the published membership fee schedule by company class. Determine whether the Chamber of Commerce qualifies as an officially recognized national authority under the repository's source standards (.gov.sa or equivalent). If it qualifies, add a verified entry to data/sources.en.json and remove this gap or set verification_status to verified.

placeholders.description: The domain chamber.org.sa is recorded as the likely official portal for the national chamber body but has not been independently confirmed. Note: this domain uses .org.sa rather than .gov.sa — confirm whether the Chamber of Commerce is an officially recognized national authority that meets this repository's source standards before adding it to data/sources.en.json.

data.name: MISA Registration Fee Schedule
data.name_alt: جدول رسوم تسجيل الاستثمار — وزارة الاستثمار
data.reason_needed: MISA registration fee schedule — exact amounts by activity type are not publicly disclosed. Fee is determined post-approval and communicated to applicant. No official published fee table found as of 2026-05-18. Check MISA e-portal after submitting application for fee notification. Priority: high — investors frequently ask about this cost. Source confirming fee structure: MISA Investor Guide 12th Edition, July 2025, Section 3.1.1.
data.next_verification_step: Submit a test application via the MISA e-portal (misa.gov.sa) or contact MISA investor services directly to obtain the current fee notification process and any published fee indicatives by activity type. If a fee schedule is published, record amounts per activity category and update the misa_investment_registration_fee and misa_annual_renewal_fee entries in data/fees.en.json.

placeholders.description: The actual fee amounts charged for each activity type are not publicly available. MISA notifies applicants of the due amount after application approval. No published fee schedule was found as of 2026-05-18.
